nom: Clinique Acne Solutions Cleansing Foam Face Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the foam cuts oil and mattifies without over-drying, and it is described as gentle on a t-zone prone to shine.
segments.dry: Some users with dry or dry-leaning combination skin note the cleanser does not leave them tight or flaky, though a few others with dry-leaning skin report it dries their skin out somewhat.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including oily-dry mixes) generally find it balances their skin and clears breakouts without pushing them toward dryness or excess oil.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive mostly say it does not irritate or sting them and still clears acne, though one sensitive-skin user reports her face became inflamed and itchy.
segments.normal: The few reviewers with normal (neither oily nor dry) skin report it works well and keeps their skin clear over months of use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s-40s and post-menopausal users report it helps control adult and hormonal acne, sometimes with some drying effect.

concerns.aging: Not discussed in these reviews; reviewers focus on acne rather than wrinkles or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the product is non-drying or only mildly drying and requires no extra moisturizer beyond routine; a minority report their skin dried out or felt stripped, especially with daily use over weeks.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visible reduction in redness around acne or general facial redness within days to weeks; one reviewer's redness appeared for unexplained reasons after starting the product.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports her face became inflamed and itchy after a week, and another reports irritation-like worsening, but most describe the formula as gentle and non-irritating even on sensitive skin.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report dark spots and acne marks fading or disappearing within one to several weeks of use, alongside acne improvement.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report noticeable reduction in cystic, hormonal, or regular acne within one to four weeks, sometimes describing dramatic clearing; a minority report breakouts got worse or the product did not prevent new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it removes excess oil and controls shine effectively while still feeling gentle.

aspects.libelle: Rich foaming lather from small amount
Leaves skin feeling soft and smooth
Effective at removing makeup and sunscreen

extraits.texte: I used it for a week and my acne got really bad but I thought it was just cause I started a new skincare so I kept on using it but after a couple days it got way worse my face was inflamed and very itchy

This is a reliable and effective product for those dealing with acne-prone skin. This foam cleanser gently removes dirt, excess oil, and impurities, helping to unclog pores and prevent breakouts. I felt that the formula is non-drying, leaving my skin feeling refreshed and balanced. With continued use, it can help improve the overall appearance of acne and promote a clearer complexion. I did find it slightly stripping so it requires moisturizing right after use.

I am a darkskinned Black woman. I have combo oily skin and I am acne-prone. My skin is also sensitive. My skin has really improved in a month using this everyday. I have a whole skin regimen, but when I switched from the cerave foaming wash to this GAME CHANGER (for me). I definitely recommend to try and I hope it works for you too!

I've been searching FOR YEARS for something that would help my break outs. I've spent thousands of dollars trying to clear my acne. This has cleared my skin and isn't drying. My skin is oily, sensitive, and acne prone. If you havent tried it, you need to!!

extraits.titre: I've struggled with acne for YEARS
extraits.texte: I first started getting acne when i was in 6th grade and continued to struggle with it as an adult. As you can imagine i tried what felt like everything short of a dermatologist since it was out of my price range. After moving across country from dry heat to humidity my skin didnt take it well and i continously broke out. I have sensitive combination skin and tried this product a couple months back, my skin hasnt been this clear since i was a child and im absolutely ESTATIC about it. Id definitely recommend to at least try it, it hasnt helped with the acne scars yet (if it even does) but its cleared out the ance to the point where i can start to focus on getting the scars corrected Short summary: at least try it, in my experience it works!

extraits.titre: I will never use a different acne treatment
extraits.texte: Easy on different skin types, mine is a combination of oily and dry and my daughter's skin is oily and it's gentle on both. Helps skin feel clean and refreshed, but I do use the 3 part treatment to avoid any breakouts.

Felt gentle enough on my combination skin, but the foaming pump stopped working after less than 2 weeks of use once a day. The liquid alone doesn't seem to create a lather so it doesn't feel like much cleaning is occurring.
